title: Non functional and no support
body: Was really excited to use the app. Downloaded and installed fine but the user interface is not working. Menu at bottom covers functionality at top so I can’t select the continue button. Also, clicking on the support like just downloads a useless file. Don’t know how this got such a high rating. Junior level design flaws and non existent support shouldn’t get one star.
author: DOCLESS

title: Disreputable dishonest company
body: Do NOT purchase!!! When faced with problems accessing app on iPhone company would not honour or back its service by issuing full refund for in app purchases paid for. Had app ten minutes and was not able to access content but when refund requested company was unwilling to provide customer satisfaction or stand behind their service and offered 25% refund as solution. Very disappointing they don’t stand behind customer satisfaction and honestly are thieves for keeping money that was not earned by providing useable app/accessible content. Buyer beware!!
